newsitem.title: USA: Federated Department Stores Inc Q4 net up.
newsitem.headline: Federated Department Stores Inc Q4 net up.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 period includes 13 weeks to Feb. 1, 1997 vs 14 weeks ended Feb. 3, 1996.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 period includes 52 weeks to Feb. 1, 1997 vs 53 weeks ended Feb. 3, 1996.

NOTE: The period which covers the 52 weeks ended February 1, 1997, includes restructuring charges of $167.7 million from costs associated with the integration of Broadway stores into the company, $33.7 million of costs related to the consolidation of Macy's stores and $41.5 million of costs related to other support operation restructurings, primarily the centralization of the company's merchandise distribution function.

The period which covers the 53 weeks ended February 3, 1996, includes charges of $139.9 million from costs associated with the integration of Macy's, $48.06 million from costs associated with the integration of Broadway stores and $14.4 million from costs related to the consolidation of the Rich's/Goldsmith's and Lazarus divisions.
Results for 1996 also include a contribution of $25.6 million to the Federated Department Stores Foundation for funding charitable giving programs of the corporation.
